acceptance_evidence.evidence: Implemented fixed 152-byte messages, 32-slot bounded queues, compile-time layout assertions, CRC32 sealing/validation, and monotonic sequence/session handling. Contract validated with contract_hash sha256:8fa26d5cc97834839e8baf95b44e51d0764d9d12fd75f5895c0e2f31ea430cae.
CoopRegion APIs map Hoenn, Kanto, Johto, and Sevii explicitly; invalid engine regions and map sections return UNSPECIFIED/rejection without Hoenn fallback.

WorldLocation is a fixed 10-byte ABI structure with u8 region, widened u16 map fields, and s16 coordinates. Export uses active map data and PlayerGetDestCoords, with conversion checks and no playerRegion usage.
Implemented four fixed independent progress slots for Hoenn, Kanto, Johto, and Sevii. Minimum-tier calculation reads only the requested region slot and does not use legacy badge flags.

main.c initializes CoopNetBridge immediately after InitHeap and polls once after callbacks and before PlayTimeCounter_Update. ROM_READY, SESSION_READY handling, heartbeat, world snapshots, and heap-free EWRAM state are implemented.

git diff --check passed. The modern build was attempted but failed only due environment/tooling conditions: arm-none-eabi-gcc was not found and check_history.sh contained CRLF line endings causing '\r: not found' and an unexpected-end-of-file syntax error.

unowned_failures: Environment failure during modern build: bash reported arm-none-eabi-gcc: command not found; check_history.sh also failed because the Windows checkout had CRLF line endings: './check_history.sh: 2: \r: not found' and './check_history.sh: 36: Syntax error: end of file unexpected (expecting "then")'.
